title: Former entrepreneur turned VC, HBS Senior Lecturer, author of three, dad of three, husband of one, civic leader, and fan of all Boston sports.
bio: Launching Technology Ventures (LTV) is an MBA elective designed for students who will join startups, launch their own companies, or work in established firms launching information technology products . Students have gone on to found or join new ventures in sectors as wide-ranging as AI, SaaS, cleantech, biotech, agtech and been a part of buil ding compa nies that have been valued at over $1 trillion . Professor Bussgang has taught the course for fifteen years and it has enrolled over 2 5 00 students.
